title: Require security review before production deployment
decision_statement: Every production deployment requires a passing security gate.

context.problem: Agents can otherwise deploy changes without the security review required by production policy.

drivers.name: Mandatory production review
drivers.criterion: Block deployment until security findings are resolved or an authorised person accepts the residual risk.

alternatives.title: Blocking security gate
alternatives.description: Security analysis must pass before a production deployment can continue.
benefits: Prevents deployment with unresolved blocking findings
drawbacks: May delay releases while findings are remediated

alternatives.title: Advisory security review
benefits: Does not add a blocking step to delivery
drawbacks: Known security findings may reach production
Does not enforce the production security policy
alternatives.rejection_reason: The authoritative policy requires security review before production deployment.

rationale: A blocking gate is the only considered alternative that enforces the authoritative production security policy while preserving an explicit human path for residual-risk acceptance.

security.summary: Production changes with unresolved blocking findings cannot be deployed.
accepted_risks: The analyzer may not detect every security defect

cost.summary: Review and remediation consume engineering time but reduce the expected cost of preventable incidents.

compliance.summary: The gate creates durable evidence that a security review occurred before production deployment.

operations.summary: The deployment path gains a reliable control but may experience longer lead time when findings require remediation.

negative: Deployments may wait for remediation or residual-risk review
risks: False positive findings may delay a deployment
The analyzer may provide incomplete coverage
actions: Retain analyzer output and residual-risk decisions

proceed: Run read-only security analysis against a proposed production deployment
always_ask: Accept or waive a residual production security finding
never: Deploy to production while a blocking security finding remains unresolved

gaps: Named human approver for residual-risk acceptance has not yet been supplied
